datasets.title: Crop production: Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) Countries Exposure Data for Disaster Risk Assessment
datasets.description: Historical and twenty-first century crop production in tons. Global gridded (4km resolution) crop yield simulations for maize, rice, soybean, and wheat, encompassing an ensemble of transient yield simulation output from eight global gridded crop models driven by bias-corrected output from five global climate models, as facilitated by the Inter-Sectoral Impact Model Intercomparison Project (ISIMIP, isimip.org). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/climada-crop-production-dataset]
datasets.details: In this API we provide datasets in a form that can readily be used in CLIMADA analyses. Users should determine whether these datasets are suitable for a particular purpose or application, considering factors such as resolution (for example, a 4km grid is not suitable for modelling risk at the neighborhood level), the way that hazards are represented in the dataset (for example, specific events, event thresholds, probabilistic event sets, etc.), the way that exposure is represented, and other aspects. Data provided with no warranty of any kind under CC BY 4.0. See respective API metadata and referenced publications for details and limitations.

contact_point.name: ETH Zürich - Weather and Climate Risks

creator.name: ETH Zürich - Weather and Climate Risks

lineage.description: Global crop yield simulations were generated by forcing eight gridded crop models with bias-corrected output from five global climate models through the ISIMIP framework. The resulting transient ensemble outputs were processed via the Climada API and aggregated to 4km resolution grids and administrative level 1 summaries for HRP countries, representing historical and 21st-century agricultural drought impacts on staple crop production.

sources.name: Inter-Sectoral Impact Model Intercomparison Project (ISIMIP)
sources.description: Ensemble of eight global gridded crop models and five global climate models providing bias-corrected transient yield simulations for agricultural drought impact assessment

sources.name: ETH Zurich Climada
sources.description: Climate risk assessment platform that processed and aggregated ISIMIP crop model outputs into gridded global datasets
